message.reasoning:
We need to write test cases for exception scenarios for toMasterFile() method. Identify possible exceptions: The method uses withReadLock which returns null after executing lambda. It calls nodeToString(sb, originNode) and nodeToString(sb, entry.getValue()). Potential exceptions: NullPointerException if origin is null (origin is a Name object). origin is used in origin.equals(entry.getKey()). If origin is null, calling equals on null throws NPE. Also originNode may be null but nodeToString may handle null; but we don't know its implementation. Could also throw IllegalStateException if data map is modified concurrently? but withReadLock ensures read lock.

Potential NoSuchElementException? Not in this method.

Also Supplier may throw RuntimeException? withReadLock may propagate.

Thus exception scenarios: 1) origin is null -> NPE when evaluating origin.equals(entry.getKey()). 2) entry.getKey() is null -> Map shouldn't have null keys (ConcurrentSkipListMap does not allow null). So not scenario.

3) entry.getValue() is null -> nodeToString may handle null but could cause NPE inside nodeToString. But we cannot assume. Could be NPE.

4) data map contains a key that is not comparable to Name leading to ClassCastException during iteration (ConcurrentSkipListMap requires comparable keys). If someone inserts a non-Name key via reflection, but not typical.

5) withReadLock may throw exception if lock acquisition fails? Not typical.

Thus we design test cases that trigger NPE due to null origin, and maybe NPE due to nodeToString internal handling.

We need to follow existing test case structure, avoid duplication. Existing tests already cover null originNode but not null origin. So we add group "Null origin handling (exception)". Provide test case expecting NullPointerException.

Also test case where data map contains entry with null value leading to exception inside nodeToString (if it doesn't handle). We can assume nodeToString throws NullPointerException when node is null. So test case expecting NPE.

Also test case where data map contains a key that is not equal to origin but origin is non-null; but entry.getKey() may be null? Not allowed. So skip.

Thus produce JSON array with groups.

Make sure format: each case input list of parameter objects. Method toMasterFile takes no parameters. So input = [].
